name: Corporate Casuals
old_description: The climbers, skiers, and backcountry wanderers at Marmot surprise people each day since 1971.
about:
Corporate Casuals operates from Concord, Massachusetts, where it has provided custom embroidery and printing services since 1980. The company runs a production facility in the historic town with a staff of approximately 15 people. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The business decorates a wide range of apparel and accessories—including polo shirts, jackets, fleece, hats, bags, and scrubs—using industrial embroidery machines and printing equipment. A proprietary production system allows on-demand fulfillment of single-unit orders, and the facility has decorated more than 8 million items to date. Customers can upload logos or use an online design studio to create artwork.

Corporate Casuals serves corporate clients, small businesses, and organizations that need branded merchandise for employees, customers, or events. The company stocks premium brands such as The North Face, Nike, Under Armour, Carhartt, and Marmot, and also supplies healthcare-oriented scrubs and lab coats as well as activewear for fitness and outdoor groups.

The company emphasizes personal service from industry professionals, advertises the fastest standard processing time in its segment, and imposes no minimum order quantities. Its founding aim was to create a system that could profitably produce custom-decorated goods one piece at a time.
